\caption{Screening tests other than HPV DNA testing at 70\% coverage, by state and Union Territory: projected crude incidence rate in 2040 and 2060 with VIA, Pap cytology and liquid-based cytology (LBC), and the 2050 results for LBC. Rates are per 100{,}000 women (means of 1000 stochastic simulations, with the 95\% interval where shown); the reduction is relative to no screening in the same year. First year CIR $<$ 4 is the first calendar year in which the mean CIR falls below 4 per 100{,}000 (the proxy for the WHO elimination threshold used in this study; -- = not reached by 2070). India row: dedicated national model; state rows: independently calibrated state models. CIR=crude incidence rate. CMR=crude mortality rate.}
